 Qadsia suffer a major blow ahead of Al-Sadd clash
 Qadsia suffer a major blow ahead of Al-Sadd clash
 Monday 26-10-2026 
 محمد أبو ريان 
 Three key players will miss Al-Qadsiah's match against Al-Sadd, scheduled for Monday evening, in the third round of the AFC Champions League Elite, a blow that could impact the team's tactical options.
 Al-Qadisiyah will be without midfielder Nahitan Nández, defender Nacho, and Ivorian Ali Diabate ahead of the match at Prince Mohammed bin Fahd Stadium in Dammam.
 The match kicks off at 9:15 PM Mecca time, as Al-Qadisiyah aims to continue their positive results and strengthen their position in the Western Group standings.
 The Saudi team is currently in sixth place with four points after winning against Al-Wasl with a score of two goals to one and then drawing with Pakhtakor, with each team scoring one goal.
 On the other hand, Al-Sadd enter the match from the bottom of the table with no points, having lost to Esteghlal by three goals to nil, and then fell to Al-Hilal by two goals to nil.
 Al-Sadd hope to recover from their two losses and secure their first points in the tournament, while Al-Qadsiah aims to overcome their injury crisis and achieve a result that boosts their chances of qualification.

 Notable numbers from round 11 of the Saudi Pro League
 Al-Hilal dominated the top of round 11 of the Saudi Pro League with a 3-2 victory over Al-Qadisiyah, with 32 goals scored and a remarkable fan attendance. 
 Saudi Pro League representatives face tough Asian tests in the elite
 Al-Hilal face Al-Shamal, Al Ahly FC take on Al-Gharafa, Al-Qadsiah meet Al-Sadd, and Al-Ittihad play Pakhtakor in the Asian round, while the match between Al-Nassr and Al-Wasl has been postponed. 
 Abu Al-Shamat: We aim to return to winning ways against Al-Sadd
 Mohammed Abu Al-Shamat confirmed that Qadsia is preparing to face Al-Sadd tomorrow in the AFC Champions League, aiming to return to winning ways. 
 Rodgers: Al-Qadsiah ready for Al-Sadd challenge and our goal is to please our fans
 Rodgers has confirmed Al-Qadsiah's readiness to face Al-Sadd tomorrow in the AFC Champions League, aiming for victory to appease the fans after losing to Al-Hilal. 
 Quiñones achieves a special record in Saudi Pro League despite loss to Al-Hilal
 Al-Qadisiyah lost to Al-Hilal 2-3, but Quiñones scored his fifth goal of the season and increased his contributions against Al-Hilal to four. 
 From Arsenal to Al-Hilal: Martinelli's unstoppable goal record
 Al-Hilal won 3-2 against Al-Qadisiyah in the Saudi Pro League, but Martinelli's muscle injury after scoring a goal dampened the joy of victory. 
 Al-Hilal beat Al-Qadisiyah 3-2 to regain top spot in Saudi Pro League
 Al-Hilal secured a thrilling victory over hosts Al-Qadisiyah 3-2 in the 11th round of the Saudi Pro League to reclaim first place with 27 points. 
 Inzaghi's decision ahead of Al-Hilal vs Al-Qadisiyah match
 Al-Hilal have traveled by road to Dammam to face league leaders Al-Qadisiyah on Friday in the 11th round of the Saudi Pro League, aiming to seize the top spot. 
 Saudi Pro League tops Asian leagues ranking with Al-Hilal leading the way
 The Saudi Pro League has topped the Asian leagues ranking, while Al-Hilal leads the ranking of Saudi clubs in AFC competitions. 
 Rodgers: Al-Hilal is the toughest opponent we have faced since taking charge
 Brendan Rodgers described Al-Hilal as the strongest opponent he has faced since taking charge of Al Qadsiah, emphasizing the importance of the upcoming clash between them in the title race.
